name: Sonix
author: 3dthc
summary: An original ROMpler instrument for Akai MPC OS standalone devices (built and tested on an MPC Live II), as a native ARM VST2 plugin on sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins. Melodic only: pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and FX, using redistributable sound libraries.
